snippet.title: Egging On | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
EGGSCLUSIVE: Egging On is out now on Steam, Playstation and Xbox.

Steam - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2897610/Egging_On/
Xbox - https://www.xbox.com/en-GB/games/store/egging-on/9PDKDBQGG2N2/0010
Playstation - https://store.playstation.com/en-in/concept/10015296

Cascade into insanity in this brutally challenging journey into the sky. Armed with nothing but a fragile shell and a slimy yolk, can you take a lone egg to new heights?
